title: What We'll Make: Drum Kit
summary: Short preview of the Drum Kit project built across this section. It frames the section goal: reacting to both button clicks and keyboard presses through DOM event listeners.

concepts.heading: What the Drum Kit does
points: The page shows a row of keys, each standing for one drum in a drum set.
Clicking a key plays the matching drum sound.
Pressing the corresponding key on the keyboard plays the same sound, so both input routes share one behaviour.
The project is the vehicle for intermediate DOM topics: attaching event listeners to buttons and to the keyboard, and responding to what the user did.
